title: Water Supply to South Kashmir Areas to Remain Disrupted for Four Days - Kashmir Life
full_text:
SRINAGAR: Water supply to 10 areas of Kokernag in south Kashmir’s Anantnag district will remain disrupted from November 7 to 10 due to essential maintenance work on the Daksum–Wangam main water supply line, the Jal Shakti Department has said.
According to a public advisory issued by the Office of the Assistant Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Public Health Engineering (PHE) Sub-Division Kokernag, the disruption is necessitated by maintenance work along the Dandipora–Gadvail stretch of the main supply line.
The affected areas include Bindoo Kokernag, Dandipora, Soyan Wangam, Zalangam, Pindobal, Bahwatoo, parts of Vailoo, Dewalgam, Adigam and Germanpora Khretty.
The department has advised residents of these areas to store adequate quantities of water in advance to meet their daily requirements during the four-day disruption period.
To minimise inconvenience, the department has also announced that water tanker services will be made available to the affected areas on an emergency basis, as and when required.
Residents requiring emergency tanker services or assistance have been asked to contact Er. Raja Mudasir at 7889703297.
The department has expressed regret over the inconvenience caused to the public.
